descriptions.d25c_spawn_group_800e61b8: Allocate a group id. Read the record named by the argument; on a negative status return 0. If the record is-a 0x803678d8 use its name list, else spawn once. For each: read the named record if listed, choose the type key from its +414 flag, create the spawn (object +28), load it by name (0x800df6a4), init it (0x800dfddc) with the two arguments, store the group at +104, copy the 12-byte position to +68 when non-null, then register its owner (virtual +20 at table +228) with 0x80164514 and the owner id. Returns the group id.
